product: first useful run requires four core decisions
fit and evidence confidence are separate
regional handoff preserves date, intent and usable time window
Southwest Michigan is narrowed by visitor cluster rather than modeled as one tiny loop
390px breakpoint prevents control and result-card overflow
decisionPromise: origin + date + time window + wine intent → best feasible Michigan wine region → explanation → regional planner handoff
truth: unknown hours are never converted to closed
missing varietal evidence is never converted to 'does not have'
reservation availability and tasting fees are not invented
positive evidence saturates so the largest dataset cannot win on record count alone
reliability: routing failure falls back to labeled travel estimates
weather failure removes the modifier rather than blocking the recommendation
common origins use curated centroids; geocoder failure yields an actionable city/ZIP error
regional adapter failure uses a dated snapshot and lowers confidence
no worthwhile region is an allowed answer
search: existing Traverse City and Petoskey canonical owners remain intact
statewide canonical is included once in sitemap and tool network

competitorBenchmark.currentMarketFinding: The closest current statewide competitor, MichiganVineyards.com, now offers preference-based region suggestions and sample itineraries, while MichiganWineMap offers a starting-town winery route planner for Lake Michigan Shore. Those products materially overlap discovery and routing, but neither was found combining arbitrary origin, selected date/time-window feasibility, separate evidence confidence, willingness to recommend against distant regions, and a state-preserving handoff into authoritative regional planners. Official tourism and wine-trail sites remain strongest at discovery after a region is chosen.

closestCompetitors.name: MichiganVineyards.com
closestCompetitors.observed: Preference-based region suggestions, statewide winery directory and sample regional itineraries.
closestCompetitors.gap: No observed day-specific origin/time feasibility engine or evidence-confidence layer before region selection.

closestCompetitors.name: Michigan Wine Map
closestCompetitors.observed: Lake Michigan Shore winery trip planner with starting town and requested winery-stop count.
closestCompetitors.gap: Useful downstream route planning, but not a statewide region-choice engine across northern and southwest regions.
